caption: The video depicts two hands working over a white tabletop scattered with magnetic pieces: pale cubes along the top edge, a cluster of bright silver spheres, a group of larger matte-gray spheres, a labeled white box, and a translucent rectangular sheet. The left hand grips a dark rectangular block magnet with a thin white ring held against it. The right hand holds a short chain of shiny silver rectangular magnets. For most of the sequence the two groups of magnets stay in contact near the center of the view. The right hand turns the silver chain while the left fingers adjust the white ring, which stays edge-on throughout. Only toward the end do the hands drift apart, pulling the ring and dark block leftward while the silver chain moves rightward and downward, opening a widening gap and carrying the right hand out of the bottom of the view. As they part, the background cubes and the translucent sheet shift within the view.

a powder/smoke/liquid outline or shadow is not automatically the boundary of a solid object;
an apparent change caused by occlusion/viewpoint is not automatically material deformation.

the appropriate material/surface itself provides visible evidence. Do not infer a force or earlier
collision just because the visible configuration would be compatible with it.

camera tracking. A single visible texture/seam does not prove spin. Avoid unnecessary absolute
claims of stillness, no motion, no camera motion or 'exactly' synchronized changes.

processes. Avoid deleting the real process merely because its cause lies outside the cropped window.

draft_caption: The video depicts two hands working over a white tabletop scattered with magnetic pieces: pale cubes along the top edge, a cluster of bright silver spheres, a group of larger matte-gray spheres, a labeled white box, and a translucent rectangular sheet. The left hand grips a dark rectangular block magnet with a thin white ring held against it. The right hand holds a short chain of shiny silver rectangular magnets. In the first frames the two groups of magnets are held in contact near the center of the frame. As the sequence progresses the hands drift apart, pulling the white ring with the dark block toward the left while the silver chain moves rightward and downward. A widening gap opens between the ring and the silver magnets, and the right hand slips out of the bottom of the view. Near the end the white ring tilts to a more edge-on angle, and the background cubes and sheet shift within the frame as the hands separate.

review_issues.quote: As the sequence progresses the hands drift apart, pulling the white ring with the dark block toward the left while the silver chain moves rightward and downward.
review_issues.problem: Misstates the timing. The two magnet groups remain in contact near the center for the majority of the clip (the right hand turning the silver chain, the left fingers adjusting the white ring); the hands only begin to drift apart near the end, so describing the drift as the progression across the whole sequence is wrong.

review_issues.quote: Near the end the white ring tilts to a more edge-on angle
review_issues.problem: Unsupported. The white ring is already seen edge-on during the long contact phase and does not tilt toward edge-on near the end; it only shows a curved band as the hands part, then returns to an edge-on line.
